newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 27.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Vice President Lien Chan and Dalai Lama meet, vow to treat each other with more open-minded attitude.
Ting Mao-shih, secretary-general of National Security Council, met high-ranking U.S. National Security Council officials in January.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Vaccines for hog foot-and-mouth disease arrive.
LIBERTY TIMES - Lien Chan meets Dalai Lama, opening new page in Taiwan-Tibet relations.
Taiwan may refocus hog industry for domestic consumption only.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Securities warrants trigger sharp fluctuations in Taiwan stock market.
Taiwan central bank not to follow Fed's rate hikes.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Fed may raise interest rates further, experts say quarter percentage point hike not enough.
